revision.claim: All finite homogeneous Lorentzian-factor gadgets with Lorentzian bond signatures and nonnegative fixed-coefficient contraction have Lorentzian effective boundary signature; cannot yield the outside-cone standard XXZ edge signature. Exact exponential local gates have the same sharp |gamma|<=alpha boundary for every positive step.

checks.scope: Exact Fraction local Euler witnesses and axis-permutation fixture; diagnostic only, not the closure proof or FPRAS.
Six exact Fraction cases verify displayed Euler Hessian eigenvectors/eigenvalues and shift independence; finite check only.

limitations: Does not cover merely log-concave non-Lorentzian high-degree tensors, signed/complex cancellations, non-Lorentzian bonds, different contraction primitives, or arbitrary global algorithms.
No hardness result, end-to-end Chen-Liu FPRAS implementation, external proof audit, or novelty/priority claim.
